basics.description: Deploys YetAnotherDmarcTool on Azure Container Apps with a private (VNet-integrated) PostgreSQL Flexible Server and Key Vault. The api and worker each run a DNSSEC resolver sidecar; the worker autoscales on the background-job queue depth. A migrate job initializes the database during deployment. Pick a deployment size on the Sizing step to pre-fill network, Postgres, and replica-count sizing — every value stays individually overridable via CLI/parameters file.

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Resource name prefix
basics.toolTip: Short prefix for resource names (a lowercase letter followed by 1-11 letters/digits).

constraints.validationMessage: 2-12 chars, lowercase letter first, then letters/digits.

basics.name: imageTag
basics.label: Image tag
basics.toolTip: Container image tag to deploy, e.g. a release like v0.1.4 or 'latest'.

elements.name: administratorLogin
elements.label: Postgres admin login
elements.toolTip: Administrator login for the PostgreSQL Flexible Server.

elements.name: dmarcAppDbPassword
elements.toolTip: Password for the non-owner runtime role the app connects as. At least 12 characters.

elements.name: fernetKey
elements.toolTip: Encrypts TOTP secrets/credentials at rest. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_'

constraints.validationMessage: A url-safe base64 32-byte key: 43 letters/digits/-/_ followed by a trailing '='. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_'

elements.name: deploymentSize
elements.label: Deployment size
elements.defaultValue: Small — a few users: up to 2 api/worker replicas, Burstable B2s Postgres. The default.
elements.toolTip: Pre-fills network, Postgres, and replica-count sizing. Every value stays individually overridable below.

allowedValues.label: Test — smallest footprint: single api/worker replica, Burstable B1ms Postgres. For trying it out, not real traffic.
Small — a few users: up to 2 api/worker replicas, Burstable B2s Postgres. The default.
Medium — a small team/MSP: up to 3 api/worker replicas, General Purpose D2ds_v4 Postgres.
Large — heavier load: 2-5 api replicas, up to 5 worker replicas, General Purpose D4ds_v4 Postgres.

elements.name: postgresHighAvailability
elements.label: Enable Postgres high availability (zone-redundant)
elements.toolTip: Adds a synchronously-replicated standby in a second Availability Zone with automatic failover. Roughly doubles Postgres compute cost. Requires a region with Availability Zone support. Not offered for Test/Small — their Burstable Postgres SKU doesn't support zone redundancy.

elements.name: publicBaseUrlOverride
elements.label: Custom base URL (optional)
elements.toolTip: e.g. https://dmarc.example.com. Leave blank to use the default Container Apps URL; bind the custom domain + managed certificate after deployment.

constraints.validationMessage: Must start with https://, or leave blank.

elements.name: platformAdminBootstrapEmail
elements.label: Bootstrap admin email
elements.toolTip: The first platform-admin account, created if none exists. Leave blank to create no admin (you'd have to seed one manually).

constraints.validationMessage: A valid email address, or leave blank.

elements.name: platformAdminBootstrapPassword
elements.toolTip: Password for the first platform admin. Required if you set an email above.

options.text: Optional. Leave blank for local email+password+TOTP login and DNS-checks-only use. Fill in to enable Entra SSO (api) and/or Microsoft Graph mailbox report ingestion (worker).
